snippet.title: Vice: Magic City Mayhem | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
November 18, 2026.

One day before GTA6. 

SUCK IT, @RockstarGames 😎

Vice: Magic City Mayhem is coming to all major platforms on day one.

Pre-order now!
👉 https://jurassicsunsetgames.com/#vice

Features:

• 2D hack-n-slash combat (with ranged elements)

• Epic and dynamic boss fights

• Exploration with environmental secrets

• Item and weapon upgrade system

• Unique dungeons with engaging puzzles
